usedFor: Anchor Browser runs browser sessions and tasks, and Zoom receives attendees through “Add a meeting registrant” when one finishes.

bestTemplate.name: “When a task is completed successfully” in Anchor Browser, then “Add a meeting registrant” in Zoom
bestTemplate.why: A finished browser task is a clear signal to register a person for a meeting.

watchOut: “Add a meeting registrant” in Zoom registers for a specified meeting, so choose the meeting and attendee in the step.
